# About Me

Hello, I'm Nandita Shankar. Welcome to my website! I am a senior undergraduate at CWRU pursuing a BS in Biology with minors in Anthropology, Chemistry, and Spanish. I am concurrently pursuing an MS in Clinical Research. 

On this website, you will find some information regarding my education and experience as well as my curriculum vitae. Please feel free to [contact me](mailto:nandita.shankar2@case.edu).
